rawFindings.title: Incorrect Windows absolute path check for paths with forward slashes
rawFindings.explanation: The condition to check if a path is an absolute Windows device path incorrectly includes both backward and forward slashes ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2]) but was modified to check only backward slashes ('\\' === path[2]). This removes support for Windows paths starting with a drive letter followed by a forward slash, such as 'C:/'. This breaks correct detection of absolute paths on Windows which can use either slash.
rawFindings.suggestion: Modify the condition to check for both backward and forward slashes again, restoring support for Windows absolute paths with forward slashes: change line 70 to `if (':' === path[1] && ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2])) return true;`

rawFindings.title: Incorrect Windows absolute path detection in utils.isAbsolute
rawFindings.explanation: The condition for detecting Windows device paths previously accepted both backslash and forward slash after the drive letter (line 70). The change restricts it to only backslash ('\\'), ignoring valid paths like 'C:/'. This breaks detection of Windows absolute paths that use forward slashes.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore original check to accept both backslash and forward slash after the drive letter: change line 70 back to: if (':' === path[1] && ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2])) return true;

rawFindings.title: Incorrect Windows absolute path check with forward slashes removed
rawFindings.explanation: The line was changed from checking both backslash and forward slash after a drive letter to only backslash. This breaks support for valid Windows absolute paths with forward slashes (e.g., 'C:/path').
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check to include both backslash and forward slash after the colon to properly support Windows absolute paths with either separator (restore original condition: `':' === path[1] && ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2])`).

rawFindings.title: Test coverage reduced by removing check for 'c:/' absolute path
rawFindings.explanation: The test asserting that 'c:/' is recognized as an absolute path was removed, meaning this case is no longer tested, potentially allowing regressions for Windows paths using forward slashes.
rawFindings.suggestion: Re-add the test to ensure that paths like 'c:/' are correctly recognized as absolute.
